title: OpenAI Codex Commands: CLI, App & IDE Cheat Sheet

facts.fact: OpenAI's CLI docs say Codex runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and that first launch prompts the user to sign in.
facts.quote: OpenAI’s CLI docs say [Codex](https://kingy.ai/news/the-complete-guide-to-openai-codex/) runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and that first launch prompts you to sign in.

facts.fact: The desktop slash-command table follows the public desktop-app reference captured on August 29, 2026.
facts.quote: This table follows the public desktop-app reference captured on August 29, 2026.

facts.fact: The August 24 Codex changelog deprecates `codex mcp-server` and directs integrations to the Codex app server.
facts.quote: The August 24 changelog deprecates `codex mcp-server` and directs integrations to the [Codex app server]

facts.fact: The `/side` command is described by OpenAI as an ephemeral fork of the conversation and is not available inside nested side or review modes.
facts.quote: OpenAI describes `/side` as an ephemeral fork of the conversation. It is not available inside nested side or review modes.

facts.fact: The `/personality` command in OpenAI's docs lists three modes: friendly, pragmatic, and none.
facts.quote: OpenAI’s docs list those three personality modes.

facts.fact: The `/approve` slash command approves one retry of a recent automatic-review denial, when automatic review is active.
facts.quote: Approve one retry of a recent automatic-review denial, when automatic review is active.

facts.fact: The `--ask-for-approval` flag accepts the values untrusted, on-request, and never.
facts.quote: | `--ask-for-approval`, `-a` | `untrusted`, `on-request`, `never` | Sets approval policy. |

facts.fact: The `--sandbox` flag accepts the values read-only, workspace-write, and danger-full-access.
facts.quote: | `--sandbox`, `-s` | `read-only`, `workspace-write`, `danger-full-access` | Sets sandbox policy. |

facts.fact: In the Codex CLI, pressing Esc twice with an empty composer edits the previous user message.
facts.quote: `Esc` twice with an empty composer | Edit the previous user message; continuing to press `Esc` walks backward.

facts.fact: The `codex cloud` `--attempts` option sets between 1 and 4 attempts.
facts.quote: Sets 1–4 attempts.

facts.fact: The `--full-auto` flag is deprecated in Codex CLI exec.
facts.quote: Deprecated full-auto behavior.

facts.fact: The `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` (alias `--yolo`) option disables approvals and sandboxing.
facts.quote: Disable approvals and sandboxing.

facts.fact: In the VS Code extension, the `chatgpt.newChat` command has a default shortcut of Cmd+N on macOS and Ctrl+N on Windows/Linux.
facts.quote: New chat; default shortcut `Cmd+N` on macOS and `Ctrl+N` on Windows/Linux.

facts.fact: OpenAI's app documentation lists the Codex app keyboard shortcuts for macOS.
facts.quote: OpenAI’s app docs list these shortcuts for macOS.

facts.fact: The `codex://new` deeplink supports query parameters such as `prompt`, `originUrl`, and `path`.
facts.quote: `codex://new` supports query parameters such as `prompt`, `originUrl`, and `path`.

facts.fact: OpenAI says custom prompts are deprecated in favor of skills, but existing custom prompts can still expose slash commands in the CLI and IDE.
facts.quote: OpenAI says custom prompts are deprecated in favor of **skills**, but existing custom prompts can still expose slash commands in the CLI and IDE.

facts.fact: Custom prompt files support positional placeholders `$1` through `$9`, `$ARGUMENTS`, named `KEY=value` placeholders, and `$$` for a literal dollar sign.
facts.quote: positional placeholders like `$1` through `$9`, `$ARGUMENTS`

facts.fact: The guide recommends `--sandbox workspace-write` for normal repository work.
facts.quote: Normal repo work | `--sandbox workspace-write`

facts.fact: The guide recommends `--sandbox read-only` for read-only investigation.
facts.quote: Read-only investigation | `--sandbox read-only`

facts.fact: The guide advises avoiding `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` / `--yolo` unless inside a disposable or isolated environment.
facts.quote: Avoid `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` / `--yolo` unless inside a disposable or isolated environment.

facts.fact: OpenAI's sandbox reference warns that bypassing sandboxing should be used carefully.
facts.quote: OpenAI’s reference documents platform-specific sandbox helper options and warns that bypassing sandboxing should be used carefully.
